messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx rate observed on gateway (us-west) — 12% error rate over 3m, spike starting 3512346760. auto-page: imran (sre-oncall).

imran (sre-oncall): Seeing it. Confirming scope — is this across all models or specific routes?

kai (platform): Quick glance at ingress: large 429 surge at token-bucket layer then upstream 502/504s. Looks like a quota enforcement change rolled ~3512346600.

maria (eng-runtime): Logs show cache warm failures then queueing. Sample log: ```[2026-03-15T10:12:45Z] gateway: upstream=backend-03 status=502 req_id=abc123 tokens=0```

sam (prodops): We deployed rate policy patch `rl-policy-v2.4` at 3512346598 for tighter per-tenant burst. Rolling that back now.

imran (sre-oncall): Do it. Also open a temporary global emergency allowance to prevent 429s becoming 5xx. Kai, can you flip the global quota?

kai (platform): On it — running: ```./infra/ctl quota set --scope=global --allowance=20% --reason="incident 3512346789 emergency"```

support-bot: Notified customers with active sessions in us-west: 14 tenants. Email template queued.

alex (support): Customer ping — "we're seeing lots of timeouts and degraded responses" from a major tenant. They're asking for ETA.

maria (eng-runtime): After rollback in place, I'm seeing drop in 429s but backlog causing some upstream timeouts. Need to scale pool or route fallback.

sam (prodops): Triggering an emergency scale of inference-pool-west: ```terraform apply -var='scale=+3' -target=module.inference_pool.us-west``` — should add capacity in ~90s.

imran (sre-oncall): While scaling, let's enable routing policy to failover non-critical tenants to lower-cost replica region to relieve us-west. Kai?

kai (platform): Adding a soft routing override for tenants with < SLA-Guarantee tag. Command: ```/routes override add --from=us-west --to=us-east --filter='tags:noncritical' --duration=10m```

maria (eng-runtime): Watchdog: I'm seeing the p99 latency slowly drop from 2.8s to 1.6s after rollback+scale. 5xx rate down to 2.3%. Keep monitoring.

imran (sre-oncall): Nice. Can someone confirm if the rate policy change was a human config error or an automated rollout? We need root cause for postmortem.

kai (platform): It was a config rollout from a scheduled canary that mistakenly included a stricter global burst limit. Patch `rl-policy-v2.4` had a template bug: `burst: 0` for default group. Rolling policy back to `rl-policy-v2.3` now.

sam (prodops): Rollback completed at 3512347035. Scaling finished, new nodes registered.

maria (eng-runtime): Upstream error logs switched to successful connect. Example: ```[2026-03-15T10:17:20Z] gateway: upstream=backend-07 status=200 req_id=def456 tokens=12 latency=320ms```

alex (support): Updated customers: sent interim notice with mitigation steps and ETA. One tenant asked for an SLA credit request form — I've flagged to account team.

imran (sre-oncall): Current status: 5xx rate steady at 0.9% (within SLO), 429s at baseline. Impacted sessions largely recovered. Marking incident as mitigated.

support-bot: Auto-note: Incident mitigation actions recorded in runbook 7.2. Creating incident ticket INC-3512346789 for follow-up.

maria (eng-runtime): Next steps I propose: 1) Postmortem on hierarchy bug in rl-policy templating. 2) Add CI guard tests for default burst > 0. 3) Add dashboard alerts for sudden 429->5xx transition.

kai (platform): Also add an automated emergency quota increase playbook (one-click in console) to avoid manual CLI steps.

imran (sre-oncall): Agreed. I'll keep the channel open for 30m for any regressions, then we'll create the doc. Great job all.

alex (support): Customers notified that services recovered. I'll coordinate credit requests if necessary.

sam (prodops): Leaving a note: command history used during mitigation: ```git ops/rl-policies@main revert rl-policy-v2.4 && infra/ctl quota set --scope=global --allowance=20%```

maria (eng-runtime): Saving logs for postmortem: `s3://redwood-incidents/3512346789/` and creating evals for latency-sensitive prompts to ensure no silent regressions.

imran (sre-oncall): Closing thread in 30m unless we see new errors. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
